final_answer:
The most decisive factor that improved stalkerware family detection was **post-scoring allowlist suppression**. This intervention raised detection within a ten-flow review budget from just two out of five families to all five [c1]. The second experimental phase introduced this **allowlist**, which removes known-benign flows after scoring [c2]. While the third phase introduced an expanded eight-sample baseline as a refinement, the allowlist was identified as the dominant, transformational factor [c4].
